{{Quote|My name is Kul Teska. And what I want, you don't have. But I'll settle for seeing the looks on your faces as your precious Clones die.|Kul Teska, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=MyNameIsKulTeska.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
'''Kul Teska''' was a [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Before he took a criminal's path, Teska was a respected [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] in the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. However, an accident with his [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suit]] left Teska disfigured and forced him to leave the Union. With the help of his knowledge in the field of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]], Teska rebuilt his pressure suit, equipping it with a variety of weapons, and became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|gun-for-hire]]. All the while, Teska continued his own experiments with [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and began construction of the [[gravitic polarization beam]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] with enough firepower to collapse a [[Star/Legends|star]]. Teska's experiments soon attracted the attention of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the Confederacy. During the Clone Wars, Teska came into Dooku's service and was provided with a [[Behpour facility|laboratory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], where the Skakoan continued the development of his weapon.

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the gravitic beam was complete, and its integral part, the [[Gravitic Core]], was to be delivered to Behpour on a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]. However, the crate containing the Core was stolen over the planet [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. Teska [[Battle of Ryloth|reclaimed]] the part and returned to his base on Behpour. When the Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] arrived on the planet, investigating rumors of a Separatist presence in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Teska captured the Senator and held her hostage. Soon, following a message delivered by Amidala, the Republic forces [[Battle of Behpour|assaulted]] Behpour. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] infiltrated the base, rescued Amidala and engaged Teska in battle in the gravitic polarization beam's core room, while the beam itself built up its power to collapse the [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo star]]. Teska was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Amidala [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the beam, causing it to destroy itself and the entire base.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Unlike General Grievous, I have no interest in trophies. However, I've always wanted to examine one of these Jedi toys.|Kul Teska, on a lightsaber|audio=TeskaUnlikeGrievous.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
[[File:Kulteska1.jpg|thumb|left|130px|Teska's enhanced pressure suit.]]
A native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skako/Legends|Skako]],<ref name="Action figure" /> the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Kul Teska worked as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] in the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. He was especially knowledgeable in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and was considered one of the company's most brilliant minds. However, an accident occurred with his [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suit]], which left his body damaged beyond repair. Ashamed of his disfigurement, Teska left the Union to focus on his personal experiments with [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and began developing the [[gravitic polarization beam]], a powerful [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of collapsing a [[Star/Legends|star]]. In addition to his research, Teska&mdash;using his knowledge of cybernetics&mdash;rebuilt his suit, equipping it with a vast array of weapons, and became a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], in order to gain credits for funding his research. Eventually, Teska's reputation rivaled the likes of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane.]] This along with his research in gravity technology and previous position as a brilliant Techno Union scientist attracted the attention of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Q&A: Teska" />

===Theft and Juma 9===
{{Quote|You and this station are finished, Jedi!|Kul Teska, to Obi-Wan Kenobi and Plo Koon|audio=JediAndStationAreFinished.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
[[File:Behpour.jpg|thumb|right|217x217px|Behpour, where Teska researched.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Dooku acquired Teska's services as both scientist and unofficial Separatist "military commander", allowing him to continue his research in a [[Behpour facility|Techno Union base]] on the planet [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="TCW:RH" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the gravitic polarization beam was finished and ready for testing, and two duplicates of its crucial part, the [[Gravitic Core]], were to be delivered to Behpour on a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]. However, Teska's rival Cad Bane infiltrated the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the planet [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] and stole one of the Cores. To cover his tracks, the bounty hunter made the other Core explode, destroying the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was carrying it; the frigate crashed on Alzoc III and created a gravitational anomaly. In order to recover the stolen part, Teska devised a plan to trace the Core by the unique energy signature it radiated. To that end, the Skakoan initiated an [[Battle of Juma 9|attack]] on the Republic [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Juma 9]], which possessed a powerful [[Radar/Legends|radar]] suited for such a purpose. Separatist [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces under Teska's command fought against [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed at Juma 9, and the scientist also had the entire station, including [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], rigged with explosives. As the battle continued, he himself infiltrated the station's communications room and initiated a radar search for the Core. Teska soon discovered that the Core was located on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], where the remnants of the local [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist army]] were [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|still fighting]] the Republic.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

[[File:Teska_explosions.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kul Teska triggers the explosives.]]
Teska contacted Dooku, requesting the remaining droid forces on Ryloth to distract the Republic long enough for him to retrieve the weapon core. As the Skakoan scientist prepared to leave, however, he was confronted by [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who happened to be at the station at the time of the Separatist attack. Igniting their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], Kenobi and Koon told Teska that they were placing him under arrest, but he ordered them not to move and demonstrated his remote detonator that was linked to the explosives. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] complied and lowered their weapons, but Teska&mdash;stating that they were "no fun"&mdash;triggered the explosives anyway and fled farther into the station with his rocket boosters, saluting his adversaries in mid-air. Eventually, Kenobi and Koon caught up with Teska, cornered him inside one of the station's chambers, and sealed the only door to prevent him from escaping. The Skakoan was unwilling to give up easily and once again brandished his detonator, threatening to destroy the escape pods, which the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were using to escape from the exploding station.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

At that moment, however, Teska's attention was distracted by the sound of an explosion, which allowed Kenobi to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-push]] the detonator out of the Skakoan's hands. In response, he attacked the two Jedi with his vast arsenal of weapons. After a lengthy battle, Teska was defeated and thrown into a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Window/Legends|window]]; the glass shattered and broke, leaving Juma 9 open to the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. He was almost sucked out of the station but was able to cling onto the edge with his hand. The vacuum also moved Teska's fallen remote detonator, and it flew toward him. The Skakoan tried to reach for it, but Kenobi threw his lightsaber at the detonator, slicing it in half. Koon then threw his own weapon at a nearby control panel, and an emergency blast door came down; Teska let go of his grasp and was sucked outside the station. His suit allowed him to survive the vacuum, and he veered off toward Ryloth, leaving Kenobi and Plo Koon stranded on the station without their weapons, which had also been sucked outside.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

===Reclaiming the Core===
{{Quote|Bane? Ha, ha, ha. Forgive my surprise. I didn't think even ''you'' were foolish enough to steal from me.''"<br />"''Pity you didn't go down with the ship, Teska.|Kul Teska and Cad Bane, upon their meeting on Ryloth|audio=TeskaBane.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
[[File:Jedi_vs.Teska.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Teska faces off against Skywalker and Tano on Ryloth.]]
On Ryloth, Teska found the Gravitic Core still in the possession of Cad Bane, who had been taken into custody by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. The two Jedi and their "prisoner" were on their way to Bane's [[Telgorn dropship]], the ''[[Sleight of Hand]]'', which they hoped to use to fly from Ryloth and secure the Core on behalf of the Republic. Teska ambushed them, emerging from a pile of wreckage surrounding Bane's starship and, after exchanging insults with the Duros, ordered him to return the Core. Teska then gripped the crate containing the Core with his built-in [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] and pulled it over to him. Skywalker, however, stated that the Core was not Bane's to give and threw the crate into the bounty hunter's ship with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Bane then tried to leave the scene, but Tano trapped him under a slab of metal.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

Teska attacked the Jedi, and after a brief skirmish he was able to trap them inside an energy field. At that moment, two clone troopers, [[Boomer (Advanced Recon Force trooper)|CS-2207]] and [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], arrived and engaged the Skakoan. After a shootout with the clones, Teska decided that it was time to retreat and activated the force field; the field began to shrink, threatening to crush the two Jedi inside. Teska then gave the clones a choice: they could either pursue him or rescue Skywalker and Tano. The clones chose the latter option, and the scientist boarded the ''Sleight of Hand'', leaving Ryloth and making his way to Behpour, where he planned to use the gravitic beam to collapse the [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo star]]. Meanwhile, [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], following the rumors of a Separatist presence in the Naboo [[Star system/Legends|system]], infiltrated Behpour and located the Techno Union base there. She was soon captured but had nonetheless delivered a message to the Jedi beforehand.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

===Death on Behpour===
{{Quote|No one messes with Cad Bane.''"<br />"''A lone gunman.|Cad Bane and Kul Teska, as the former exacts his revenge|audio=LoneGunman.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
Following Amidala's message and the information they had managed to uncover on Juma 9, the Jedi initiated an [[Battle of Behpour|assault]] on Behpour, hoping to destroy the Separatists' new superweapon and free the senator. After Skywalker and Tano had infiltrated the Techno Union base, Teska contacted them over the comm system and told them to surrender to him under threat of [[Death/Legends|killing]] Amidala. Skywalker seemingly complied and went to Teska, who had tied Amidala in the gravitic beam's core room and was keeping her hanging from the roof there. When Skywalker arrived, the Skakoan ordered him to surrender his lightsaber&mdash;which Teska wanted to study&mdash;and told the Jedi not to use any "tricks." After Skywalker gave him his weapon, Teska placed it on his belt and proceeded to tell Skywalker that he considered his surrender to be an act of cowardice. He told the Jedi that he would normally suspect a trick, but in Teska's opinion, Skywalker was out of options this time. However, the scientist then noticed Skywalker glimpsing behind his back and looked back. He saw Ahsoka Tano, who had been trying to move Amidala to safety with the Force while Teska was conversing with Skywalker.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

[[File:KulTeska-TCWRH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kul Teska's last moments.]]
Enraged, Teska shot at Tano with his quad cannon, but she deflected all of his [[Laser/Legends|shots]] with her lightsaber. At the same time, Skywalker [[Force jump/Legends|leaped forward]], grabbing Amidala and moving her to safety before sending her to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the scientist's weapon. Moreover, Tano Force-pulled Skywalker's lightsaber from Teska's belt and threw it back to her Master; both Jedi then confronted the Skakoan. As their duel moved closer to the room's central platform, the superweapon's firing system was initiated, and the gravitic beam began to power up for its devastating shot. At that moment, Cad Bane&mdash;who had escaped from the Jedi on Ryloth and had made his way to Behpour&mdash;appeared in the room<ref name="TCW:RH" /> and fired at Teska's rocket boosters, stranding the Skakoan on the room's central platform.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes: Prima Official Game Guide">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

Having exacted his revenge on his hated rival, Bane walked away from the scene. Nevertheless, Kul Teska was certain that he would be victorious and continued attacking Skywalker and Tano from the central platform until he was defeated and thrown into the gravitic beam itself. Shattered by the beam's power, Teska's pressure suit malfunctioned and the Skakoan died; his last words were that the Jedi had already lost. Amidala, however, had been able to sabotage the beam, Skywalker redirecting her to a power regulator where she sabotaged the weapon. Instead of collapsing the Naboo sun, it destroyed the Behpour laboratory, moments after the Jedi and the senator had evacuated the premises in Skywalker's [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].<ref name="TCW:RH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am unbeatable!|Kul Teska|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
Kul Teska was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Skakoan.<ref name="TCW:RH" /> He was a highly intelligent, creative, and driven individual. A renowned scientist, Teska possessed a natural talent with cybernetics, one that allowed him to build his modified pressure suit.<ref name="Q&A: Teska" /> As a mercenary, Teska was known for his ruthlessness and excessive methods, which put him in direct competition with the likes of fellow bounty hunter Cad Bane.<ref name="Databank">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|Databank}}</ref> Teska was also often times arrogant<ref name="TCW:RH" /> and had a brash attitude with a short fuse. He was not intimidated by anyone<ref name="Q&A: Teska" /> and believed no foe, clone, or Jedi could match his strength. He often stated that he was unbeatable and considered Cad Bane's attempt to steal the Gravitic Core from him foolish. During battle, Teska often taunted his opponents, stating that their cause was hopeless and that they would soon be dead, as well as diminishing the Jedi's [[Force power/Legends|skills]] with the Force and their faith in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Clone Army]]. He was self-confident, believing that Skywalker was out of options on Behpour. The Skakoan considered Skywalker's surrender to be a display of cowardice, only to find out that the Jedi had in fact tricked him.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

If an opponent gained the upper hand over Teska, he did admit to his enemy's prowess to a certain extent. Both Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano found this trait annoying and believed that Teska was talking too much. Kul Teska was not afraid of mass slaughter, and he was intent on destroying the escape pods, killing the clones on Juma 9, and collapsing the Naboo sun, which would have had catastrophic effects on the entire Naboo system. He did not possess an interest in collecting any kind of trophies like the Count Dooku's dreaded enforcer, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], did. Nonetheless, Teska admitted that he had always wanted to examine a Jedi Knight's lightsaber.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|He's resourceful, I'll give him that.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=HesResourceful.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
[[File:KulTeska2-TCWRH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Teska's quad-arm cannon.]]
Kul Teska's pressure suit was equipped with a variety of weaponry and tools. His suit itself allowed him to survive the vacuum of space. It was outfitted with rocket boosters, enabling Teska to hover in midair and even fly, a technique he often used in battle. Teska's right arm was outfitted with a rotary quad [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] and a grappling hook. Two [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] were mounted on the suit's shoulders,<ref name="TCW:RH" /> along with concealed [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]],<ref name="Action figure" /> and a powerful laser beam weapon was located in its chest. Teska was also capable of creating a shockwave that threw all opponents off of him. The defensive systems of the suit included a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], which created an energy shield, protecting Teska from enemy fire.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

Although Teska was capable of quickly fixing it even during battle, the suit was prone to malfunction. The boosters in particular were not very reliable, as they malfunctioned when Bane fired at them. In addition to those built into his suit, Teska also used other mechanisms. During the battle on Juma 9, he made use of explosives, which he had planted throughout the station. On Ryloth, Teska trapped Skywalker and Tano inside an energy field with the help of a portable generator.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kul Teska was created as an antagonist for the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'', in which he was voiced by [[Troy Baker]].<ref name="TCW:RH" /> The game, developed by [[Krome Studios]] and published by [[LucasArts]], serves as a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. According to the game's assistant producer, Chris Lee, the creation of Teska's character was a collaborative effort between Krome Studios, LucasArts, and [[Lucasfilm Animation]] and was aimed at creating a unique and intriguing new villain for ''The Clone Wars'' universe. The production team envisioned Teska as a classic villain, albeit the one with his own reasons.<ref name="Q&A: Teska" /> The developers hoped to create a character that players could love and hate at the same time, a character surrounded by mystery that would draw interest in finding out more about him.<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.thehdroom.com/news/Exclusive_LucasArts_Discusses_Clone_Wars_Republic_Heroes/5518|text=LucasArts Discusses ''Clone Wars Republic Heroes''|archivedate=20120510180959}}</ref>

Teska's fight against Skywalker, Tano, and the clones on Ryloth is omitted from the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] version of the game, as Teska retreats aboard the ''Sleight of Hand'' right after Skywalker throws the Gravitic Core there. In [[2010]], a [[Toys "R" Us]] exclusive action figure of Kul Teska was released by [[Hasbro]].<ref name="Action figure" />

===Nintendo DS edition===
Teska was also featured in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of ''Republic Heroes'', developed by [[Lucasfilm Animation Singapore]]. As revealed in the final cutscene, this version of the game is intended to serve as a prequel of sorts to all other versions of ''Republic Heroes''. In it, while preparing a retreat from Ryloth, the Confederacy plans to destroy the [[City/Legends|city]] in which they are based with [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. The Republic tries to prevent the massacre but finds itself unable to contact its [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and request assistance because of a Separatist tower-mounted jamming device in that city. To this end, Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] infiltrates the city and reaches the top of the tower with the device. Kul Teska suddenly appears, trying to prevent Windu from destroying the jammer. After a short battle, Windu manages to defeat the Skakoan by deflecting his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots back at him with his lightsaber. Teska is forced to retreat, and Windu destroys the jamming device.<ref name="DS edition">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition}}</ref>

Later in the game, General Grievous attempts to overthrow his master, [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku, by acquiring a biological superweapon on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. His plan fails, and the Jedi manage to defeat the droid commander, forcing him to flee back to the Separatists. Discovering his treachery, Dooku spares Grievous, stating that the Jedi's preoccupation with Grievous's rebellion gave him time to develop his own weapon on Behpour, hinting at Teska's development of the gravitic beam. The overall Nintendo DS's storyline, however, is rather confusing and contradictory in nature and incorporating it would require too much [[Fanon|fan-based speculation]]. Because of this, this article assumes that the events portrayed in the NDS version are non-[[canon]].<ref name="DS edition" />
